question: Which of the following cells are found in the liver of mammals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kupffer cells.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kupffer cells** are found in the **liver of mammals.**
 
• Kupffer cells are **specialized macrophages** found in the liver, responsible for **removing foreign substances** such as bacteria and old red blood cells from the **bloodstream. ​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purkinje cells** are a type of **neuron **found in the **cerebellum of the brain**, involved in controlling **movement and coordination.**
 
• **Microglial cells** are immune cells found in the** central nervous system,** responsible for** maintaining brain health **and responding to** injury or infection.**
 
• **Sensory cells** are specialized cells found in the **sense organs**, such as the **eyes, ears, and nose, **responsible for **detecting stimuli **and **transmitting signals **to the brain.
 
• Therefore, option 1 (Purkinje cells), option 2 (Microglial cells), and option 4 (Sensory cells) are **incorrect **as they are not found in the liver of mammals.
